boundary: run(input): the input is typed as records and @tag("op")/@tag("action") variants whose runtime representation is the JSON value itself (zero input conversion); string payloads decode via fflate's strToU8 and byte arrays via Uint8Array.fromArray; one-shot byte ops return raw Uint8Array directly, strFromU8 encodes UTF-16LE bytes, streaming ops frame ondata chunks, and expectErrorCode catches FlateError into Uint8Array([0xff, code]).
